# hook

Types from PocketBase's Go package `hook`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [hook](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/hook).

## hook.Event

Event implements `Resolver` and it is intended to be used as a base
Hook event that you can embed in your custom typed event structs.

Example:

```
	type CustomEvent struct {
		hook.Event

		SomeField int
	}
```

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `extra` | <code>{ [key: string]: any }</code> | Extra holds any dynamic data that could be passed between event handlers. |
| `next()` | <code>(): void</code> | Next calls the next hook handler. |

## hook.Handler

Handler defines a single Hook handler.
Multiple handlers can share the same id.
If Id is not explicitly set it will be autogenerated by Hook.Add and Hook.AddHandler.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `func` | <code>(_arg0: T) =&gt; void</code> | Func defines the handler function to execute. |
| `id` | <code>string</code> | Id is the unique identifier of the handler. |
| `priority` | <code>number</code> | Priority allows changing the default exec priority of the handler within a hook. |

## hook.Hook

Hook defines a generic concurrent safe structure for managing event hooks.

When using custom event it must embed the base [`hook.event`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/hook#hookevent).

Example:

```
	type CustomEvent struct {
		hook.Event
		SomeField int
	}

	h := Hook[*CustomEvent]{}

	h.BindFunc(func(e *CustomEvent) error {
		println(e.SomeField)

		return e.Next()
	})

	h.Trigger(&CustomEvent{ SomeField: 123 })
```

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `bind()` | <code>(handler: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/hook#hookhandler">Handler</a>&lt;T&gt;): string</code> | Bind registers the provided handler to the current hooks queue. |
| `bindFunc()` | <code>(fn: (e: T) =&gt; void): string</code> | BindFunc is similar to Bind but registers a new handler from just the provided function. |
| `unbind()` | <code>(...idsToRemove: string[]): void</code> | Unbind removes one or many hook handler by their id. |
| `unbindAll()` | <code>(): void</code> | UnbindAll removes all registered handlers. |
| `length()` | <code>(): number</code> | Length returns to total number of registered hook handlers. |
| `trigger()` | <code>(event: T, ...oneOffHandlerFuncs: ((_arg0: T) =&gt; void)[]): void</code> | Trigger executes all registered hook handlers one by one with the specified event as an argument. |

## hook.TaggedHook

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `canTriggerOn()` | <code>(tagsToCheck: Array&lt;string&gt;): boolean</code> | CanTriggerOn checks if the current TaggedHook can be triggered with the provided event data tags. |
| `bind()` | <code>(handler: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/hook#hookhandler">Handler</a>&lt;T&gt;): string</code> | Bind registers the provided handler to the current hooks queue. |
